TRUTH CHECK: The paper describes three different CSF experiments: 1) SDS-PAGE (46 slices from depleted + 37 from bound = 83), 2) Mixed Mode Global (66 fractions from depleted + 10 from bound = 76), and 3) Glycopeptide mapping (20 fractions).
